job.title: Marketing & Growth Lead
job.description:
Marketing & Growth Lead

£70,000–£80,000 | Home-based, UK | Full-time

Ever looked at a product and thought, “I know how I’d get people excited about that”? Here’s your opportunity to put that thinking into action.

We’re partnering with an ambitious pet technology business developing a smarter way for cat owners to understand their cats’ everyday behaviour.
With fresh investment, an evolving product and an experienced team across technology, product and customer experience, the business is preparing for its next commercial chapter. Now it needs a marketer who can turn customer insight into a compelling proposition, build the plan and make it happen.
You’ll own the marketing direction, with the freedom to challenge assumptions, test ideas and show where investment delivers results. The US is the priority market, giving you the opportunity to shape how the product reaches and connects with a significant consumer audience.

The opportunity

This is a role for someone who enjoys both deciding what to do and doing it.
You might already lead marketing in a small business. You could be a brilliant Growth Marketing Manager or Senior Digital Marketer ready for broader ownership. Perhaps you’re working within a larger team and want the freedom to put your own ideas into practice.

Your current title matters less than your ability to explain: “Here’s the challenge, here’s what I personally did, and here’s what happened.”
You’ll join a small, collaborative team where your work will influence how the product is positioned, how customers experience it and where the business goes next.

What you’ll get stuck into
  • Find the strongest opportunity. Build on existing research to understand priority customer groups, buying motivations and the competitive landscape.
  • Make the proposition compelling. Translate a connected technology product into clear, credible messaging that helps cat owners understand its value.
  • Turn ideas into customers. Personally run and improve paid campaigns, creative tests, ecommerce journeys and landing pages.
  • Follow the evidence. Establish useful reporting, understand acquisition costs and conversion, and recommend where to invest, improve or stop.
  • Bring customer stories to life. Work with Customer Experience on genuine insights, user-generated content and communications that encourage product adoption and ongoing engagement.
  • Shape the relaunch. Develop campaign priorities and channel plans around product readiness and what testing reveals.
  • Put AI to practical use. Identify workflows that improve marketing delivery, analysis and productivity, working with the CTO on technical implementation.
You’ll have colleagues to challenge ideas with and specialist expertise to draw on. You’ll also be the person taking ownership of marketing delivery, with no direct reports initially.

What you’ll bring

You’ll have recent, hands-on experience in consumer marketing, ideally within DTC ecommerce, consumer technology, connected devices, subscriptions or a similarly relevant business.

We’re particularly interested in people who can demonstrate:
  • Commercial judgement across positioning, customer acquisition and conversion.
  • Personal delivery across paid social, ecommerce, analytics, creative testing and customer lifecycle activity.
  • Experience improving a B2C website, ideally Shopify.
  • Confidence working with budgets, interpreting results and making decisions.
  • Practical experience using AI in your work, plus curiosity about what it could help you do next.
  • The initiative to work independently, ask good questions and adapt when an experiment doesn’t deliver.
You don’t need to code or build integrations. 

The technical team will lead that work. You do need to understand what marketing needs from those systems and whether the outputs are useful.
Pet industry experience and exposure to the US market would be valuable. Above all, you’ll bring relevant skills and a real interest in the product and its customers. If you share your home with a cat, you’ll probably have plenty of ideas already.

The practical details
  • £70,000–£80,000 basic salary.
  • 24 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some allowance reserved for the Christmas closure.
  • Workplace pension.
  • Home-based in the UK, with in-person collaboration in Winchester or London, anticipated approximately fortnightly during the initial period.
  • 40 hours per week, with flexible working, core availability around 10am–3pm and flexibility to connect with US contacts when needed.
Interested? Let’s hear what you’ve built.

Apply with your CV and a short example of a marketing challenge you personally tackled, what you did and the result.

For a confidential conversation, contact Katie Fletcher at The Animal People Recruitment Company.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

job.title: Vice President Operations
job.description:
Vice President of Operations
Location: Philadelphia, PA Reporting to: Chief Operating Officer

About Us
We are a fast-growing US pet products business with an established presence across the retail and e-commerce markets. Driven by a passion for improving the lives of pets and the people who love them, we have experienced significant growth in recent years and have ambitious plans for the future.
As the business continues to expand its product portfolio, distribution network and customer base, we are investing in the people, processes and infrastructure needed to support our next stage of growth.

Role Overview
This is an exciting senior leadership opportunity at a pivotal time in the company's journey. The Vice President of Operations will take ownership of the end-to-end US operations and supply chain function, playing a central role in building the operational capability required to support the company's ambitious growth plans.
Working closely with the Chief Operating Officer and Executive Team, this position will be responsible for developing and executing the operational strategy, overseeing international manufacturing relationships, strengthening supply chain performance and ensuring products are delivered efficiently, consistently and to the highest quality standards.
The successful candidate will bring a combination of strategic thinking and hands-on operational experience, with the commercial awareness to balance growth, profitability and customer experience. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact within a growing business, shaping the operational infrastructure, team and processes that will support its continued success.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Strategy & Leadership
  • Develop and execute the overall operations strategy, ensuring alignment with the company's wider commercial objectives and growth ambitions.
  • Lead the development of annual operating plans, departmental budgets and operational priorities.
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing Operations team, establishing clear objectives, accountability and opportunities for progression.
  • Work closely with the COO and Executive Team to identify opportunities for operational improvement and business growth.
  • Establish KPIs, reporting processes and performance measures to drive visibility, accountability and informed decision-making.
Supply Chain & Manufacturing
  • Oversee the end-to-end supply chain, including demand and supply planning, purchasing, production, quality, logistics and fulfilment.
  • Lead relationships with international manufacturing partners and suppliers, managing capacity planning, commercial negotiations, performance and service agreements.
  • Own the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, ensuring effective alignment between demand forecasts, inventory requirements, production and purchasing.
  • Develop supply chain resilience through effective risk management, dual sourcing and business continuity planning.
  • Support new product development and launches, coordinating operational requirements from initial development through to production and delivery.
Logistics & Distribution
  • Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, freight forwarding, customs, import compliance, warehousing and third-party logistics partners.
  • Manage order fulfilment across retail, distributor and e-commerce channels, including Amazon and major retail customers.
  • Drive improvements in delivery performance, inventory availability and retailer compliance, including EDI, routing guides and chargeback management.
  • Ensure operational processes can support increasing volumes and expanding distribution requirements.
Commercial & Financial Performance
  • Take ownership of operational financial performance, including cost of goods, landed costs, freight expenditure, working capital and inventory management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability without compromising product quality or customer service.
  • Develop and manage departmental budgets, forecasts and operational investment plans.
  • Monitor inventory health, balancing availability, stock turnover and aged inventory.
  • Provide regular operational and financial performance updates to the Executive Team.
Systems & Continuous Improvement
  • Lead the development and implementation of scalable operational systems, processes and reporting capabilities.
  • Oversee the effective use of ERP, planning, warehouse and reporting platforms, including NetSuite and Power BI.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce automation and AI to improve planning, reporting and operational efficiency.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration and operational excellence across the business.
What We're Looking For

Essential Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • At least 8 years' progressive experience within operations and supply chain, including a minimum of 3 years in a senior leadership position at Director level or above.
  • Proven experience leading end-to-end operations and supply chain functions within a consumer products business.
  • Experience managing international contract manufacturers, overseas suppliers and import operations.
  • Demonstrable experience leading, developing and building high-performing teams, including managers.
  • Strong commercial and financial understanding, including budgeting, COGS, landed costs, working capital and P&L impact.
  • Experience supporting retail and e-commerce distribution channels, with knowledge of retailer compliance, EDI, routing guides and chargebacks.
  • Experience working with ERP systems, with NetSuite strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to develop and interpret operational KPIs and performance reporting.
Desirable Experience
  • Previous experience within the pet industry, particularly working with pet specialty, mass retail or e-commerce customers.
  • Experience scaling operations within a growing, founder-led or mid-sized business.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced qualification.
  • APICS/ASCM, CPIM, CSCP, Lean Six Sigma or similar professional certification.
  • Experience with Power BI, Shopify, WMS platforms and supply chain planning tools.
  • Knowledge of international trade programmes, tariff mitigation and customs compliance.
  • Experience applying automation or AI to operational processes.
Skills & Personal Attributes
  • Strategic and commercially minded, with the ability to translate business objectives into practical operational plans.
  • A confident and collaborative leader who can influence and communicate effectively at every level of an organisation.
  • Equally comfortable setting strategic direction and getting involved in the detail when required.
  • An effective negotiator with strong supplier and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical and solutions-focused, with a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to navigate a growing and sometimes unpredictable environment.
  • A hands-on approach, with a willingness to take ownership and contribute wherever needed.
  • Passionate about building a positive, collaborative and accountable team culture.
Additional Requirements
  • Must reside within a commutable distance of Philadelphia, PA.
  • Position requires approximately 10-25% travel, including overnight and international visits to manufacturing partners.
  • Willingness to participate occasionally in community events, volunteering activities and local initiatives.
What We Offer
  • An opportunity to join a fast-growing business at an exciting stage of its development.
  • A senior leadership position with direct exposure to the COO, CEO and Executive Team.
  • The opportunity to shape the operational strategy, infrastructure and team as the business continues to scale.
  • A collaborative, energetic and dog-loving working environment.
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the future growth of an established US pet business.

job.title: Territory Manager - South East
job.description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing startup on a mission to help veterinary clinics across the UK operate more sustainably. Our innovative solution supports practices in reducing environmental impact and reduces clinical staff exposure to harmful waste anaesthetic gases.

Role Overview

This is a very exciting opportunity at a pivotal time in the company journey. You will help drive the success in our core UK veterinary market. With this responsibility will bring a tremendous opportunity to build excellent experience and enjoy career defining success.

We are seeking an ambitious and motivated Territory Managers to drive growth within the UK veterinary sector. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, enjoys building relationships from the ground up, and is passionate about sustainability.

You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, engaging veterinary clinics, managing the sales cycle end-to-end, and building strong engagement and trust with our customers.


Key Responsibilities
  • Identify, prospect, and engage veterinary clinics across your territory and the wider UK as necessary
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline from initial outreach to close
  • Conduct product demonstrations and presentations (in-person and virtual)
  • Understand clinic operations and tailor solutions to customer needs
  • Develop long-term relationships with practice owners, managers, and clinical teams
  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets
  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM system
  • Gather market and customer feedback to inform product evolution and refine commercialisation strategy
  • Represent the company at veterinary events, conferences, and trade shows
  
What We’re Looking For
  • Proven experience in B2B sales (veterinary sector preferred)
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently in a startup environment
  • Comfortable with outbound sales and consultative selling
  • Passion for sustainability and positive environmental impact
  • Willingness to travel within territory and further afield if necessary (Head office in the South West and industry events)
  • Full right to work in the United Kingdom
Nice to Have
  • Experience selling to veterinary clinics
  • Familiarity with sustainability, waste reduction, or environmental compliance solutions
  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or high-growth company
What We Offer
  • Competitive base salary (up to £40K) with performance-based commission
  • Car allowance
  • Share options
  • Opportunity to join an early-stage company and shape its growth
  • Meaningful work with real environmental impact
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Career progression as the company scales

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Location
Head office: South West, UK (Hybrid working) 

About Us
We are a fast-growing startup on a mission to help veterinary clinics across the UK operate more sustainably. Our innovative solution supports practices in reducing environmental impact and reduces clinical staff exposure to harmful waste anaesthetic gases.

Role Overview
This is a very exciting cross-functional role at a pivotal time in the company journey. This role will be responsible for driving success in our core UK veterinary market. With this responsibility will bring a tremendous opportunity to build excellent experience and enjoy career defining success.
The role will act as the central point of coordination between sales, operations, product development, customer support, finance, marketing, and external partners. The Product Manager will own the veterinary market strategy and execution, ensuring that commercial objectives are achieved while delivering exceptional service delivery and value to veterinary customers.
The Product Manager is responsible for the commercial success, operational performance, and ongoing development of the company's anaesthetic gas capture device and associated service offering within the UK veterinary market.
The successful candidate will possess well-developed commerciality to drive market growth while ensuring the product and service continue to evolve in response to customer needs, playing a core role in the success of the business.
  
Key Responsibilities

Commercial Management
  • Develop and execute the UK veterinary market strategy.
  • Own the commercial performance of the veterinary product portfolio.
  • Identify market opportunities, customer needs and competitive threats.
  • Develop pricing strategies and commercial propositions.
  • Monitor market trends, wider competing technologies and customer feedback to inform business decisions.
  • Build relationships with key veterinary groups, distributors and strategic partners.
  • Support the development of business cases for new initiatives and associated investment of resources.
  • Develop range of commercial KPIs for veterinary channel
  
Sales Support
  • Work closely with the sales team to develop and deliver sales strategies.
  • Create sales tools, product positioning and value propositions.
  • Support key customer meetings and commercial negotiations where appropriate.
  • Deliver product training for sales teams and distribution partners.
  • Monitor sales performance and implement actions to improve conversion and growth.
  • Support customer acquisition and retention initiatives.
  
Product Management and Development
  • Own the product roadmap for the veterinary market.
  • Gather customer insights and translate them into product improvements.
  • Coordinate product development activities with engineering and research teams.
  • Prioritise enhancements based on commercial value, customer impact and technical feasibility.
  • Liaise with regulatory colleagues to ensure the product remains compliant with relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Manage product launches, updates and lifecycle planning.
  
Operational Management
  • Liaise with operational colleagues to support the veterinary business.
  • Work with operations and engineering teams to ensure reliable product and service availability.
  • Monitor service delivery performance and customer satisfaction, and as a result take steps to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
  • Develop scalable processes to support business growth.
  • Identify operational risks and implement mitigation plans.
  
Financial Performance
  • Own revenue, profitability and growth targets for the veterinary market, developing improvement initiatives where necessary.
  • Develop annual budgets and sales forecasts, and feed in to product and service supply planning.
  • Monitor commercial and financial performance against plan and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
  • Produce regular performance reports and business updates with action plan to build on success and remedy shortfalls.
  
Marketing
  • Work with marketing colleagues to develop campaigns that support business growth.
  • Ensure consistent messaging and positioning across all channels.
  • Support exhibitions, conferences and veterinary events.
  • Develop educational content and customer communications.
  • Build customer advocacy and feedback through customer case studies and testimonials.
  
Customer Experience
  • Resolve complex customer issues through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Monitor and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  
What We’re Looking For

Essential Experience
  • Experience in the veterinary sector, possibly already in product or some form of commercial management, but above all demonstrating well-developed commerciality.
  • Proven ability of cross functional working across the business, including experience working with sales teams and customers.
  • Commercial experience with technical or medical products delivering revenue and profitability targets.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Financial planning and budgeting experience.
  • Excellent organisational and project management skills.
  
Desirable Experience
  • Experience with environmentally focused technologies or sustainability solutions, or demonstrable personal drive for a sustainable planet.
  • Knowledge of anaesthesia, operating theatre equipment or gas management systems.
  • Experience managing regulated products.
  • Experience working with distributors and channel partners.
  
Skills & Personal Attributes
  • Commercially minded with an entrepreneurial approach.
  • Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Passionate about innovation, sustainability and improving environmental outcomes within veterinary practice.
  • Able to make decisions even when analysis will only take you so far.
  • Collaborative and effective at building relationships through great communication and negotiation.
  • Curious and customer-focused, with a passion for understanding market needs.
  • Proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to manage ambiguity.
  • Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  
What We Offer
  • Competitive base salary with performance-based commission
  • Share Options
  • Opportunity to join an early-stage company and shape its growth
  • Meaningful work with real environmental impact
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Career progression as the company scales

job.title: Head of Commercial Partnerships
job.description:
Salary: £100,000–£120,000 basic salary, depending on experience, plus performance-related bonus of up to 12%

Location: Flexible, with remote working considered for the right candidate. Regular travel to company sites in the South East of England and to European sites will be required.

The opportunity
Are you a scientifically driven commercial leader who can bridge the gap between cutting-edge biotechnology and commercial success?

Our client is a specialist biotechnology company developing novel biological therapies for veterinary disease areas. With established laboratory facilities at sites in the South East of England and a growing European presence, the business is advancing innovative approaches to developing high-quality, specific and affordable biological medicines for animal health.

As the company continues to grow, we are looking for a Head of Commercial Partnerships to play a pivotal role in its next phase of development.

This is a senior, high-impact opportunity for someone who combines a strong scientific background with proven commercial acumen. You will take ownership of established strategic partnerships, develop new commercial relationships, lead licensing discussions and help shape the company's commercial strategy.

You will represent the business in discussions with major animal health pharmaceutical businesses, where scientific credibility is essential.
You will need to understand the science behind antibody therapeutics, engage confidently with highly experienced scientific and commercial stakeholders, and translate complex scientific opportunities into compelling commercial propositions.

Working closely with the senior leadership team, you will have the opportunity to influence business direction, identify new opportunities for the company's technology and help turn scientific innovation into sustainable commercial growth.

The role
This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on commercial delivery. Approximately half of your time will focus on developing new partnerships and commercial opportunities, with the remainder dedicated to managing and growing existing relationships.

Strategic partnerships and account management
  • Take ownership of day-to-day relationships with established strategic partners, acting as a trusted and credible point of contact.
  • Strengthen existing partnerships by understanding partner priorities, identifying new opportunities and ensuring effective communication across organisations.
  • Build long-term relationships with senior scientific, technical and commercial stakeholders within major animal health pharmaceutical businesses.
  • Represent the company in important partner meetings, working closely with the scientific team and senior leadership as appropriate.
  • Ensure partnerships deliver mutual value and support the company's wider commercial objectives.

New business development and commercial growth
  • Identify, develop and secure new commercial partnerships with major and mid-sized animal health pharmaceutical companies.
  • Build relationships with prospective partners and licensees, developing a strong pipeline of commercial opportunities.
  • Identify new applications for the company's technology across companion animal and livestock health.
  • Evaluate market opportunities, understand customer needs and develop compelling commercial propositions.
  • Represent the company at relevant industry meetings, conferences and partnering events to raise awareness and generate new opportunities.
  • Build credibility with potential partners by articulating both the scientific potential and commercial value of the company's approach.

Licensing, negotiations and deal-making
  • Lead licensing discussions and commercial negotiations with prospective partners and licensees.
  • Develop and negotiate commercial agreements, working towards sustainable, mutually beneficial outcomes.
  • Assess potential deal structures and valuations, balancing commercial opportunity with the company's strategic objectives.
  • Work collaboratively with scientific, operational, legal and financial colleagues to progress opportunities from initial discussions through to agreement.
  • Manage the development of licensing opportunities around the company's technology and internal pipeline.

Commercial strategy and business planning
  • Review and refine the existing commercial strategy, developing a clear plan for the next stage of business growth.
  • Identify priority markets, target partners and opportunities to maximise the commercial potential of the company's technology.
  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, measurable KPIs and commercial targets.
  • Monitor the partnership pipeline, market developments, forecasts and progress against agreed objectives.
  • Work with the senior leadership team to evaluate opportunities, allocate resources and make informed commercial decisions.
  • Bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping the business respond to new opportunities as it continues to grow.

Leadership and collaboration
  • Work closely with the senior leadership team, including the relevant reporting lead, to shape and deliver commercial priorities.
  • Collaborate with scientific colleagues across the company's sites to ensure commercial opportunities are aligned with scientific capabilities and development priorities.
  • Provide clear recommendations on the resources, systems and support needed to deliver the commercial strategy.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, professional and ambitious culture as an integral member of the wider business.

This is initially an individual-contributor role, without direct reports. However, it offers significant scope to influence the business and its commercial direction as the organisation develops.

About you
We are looking for an individual who can operate confidently at the intersection of science, animal health and commercial business development.
You may currently hold a senior commercial, business development, licensing or strategic partnerships position within animal health pharmaceuticals or biotechnology. Alternatively, you may have developed a strong scientific career before moving into commercial leadership, licensing or alliance management.
What matters most is that you can demonstrate both scientific depth and the commercial capability to turn that knowledge into successful partnerships and deals.

Essential experience and expertise
  • A strong scientific or veterinary background, normally supported by a Master's degree or higher in a relevant scientific discipline, or a veterinary qualification.
  • Substantial experience in business development, commercial partnerships, licensing or alliance management, ideally at senior level and with approximately 10 years or more of relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge of the animal health pharmaceutical sector, ideally spanning both companion animals and livestock.
  • A deep understanding of antibody discovery, antibody therapeutics or related biological therapies, with the ability to discuss the science confidently and credibly with expert scientific stakeholders.
  • Experience developing strategic relationships with pharmaceutical, biotechnology or animal health organisations.
  • A proven track record in commercial negotiations, deal development and securing successful partnerships or agreements.
  • The ability to understand complex scientific concepts and communicate their potential commercial value clearly.
  • Experience contributing to commercial strategy, business planning, pipeline development and measurable growth objectives.
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, influencing and negotiation skills.

The qualities that will set you apart
  • You can engage with senior scientific experts on their own terms, ask informed questions and establish credibility through your understanding of the science.
  • You combine scientific curiosity with a commercial mindset, recognising where promising technology can meet a genuine market need.
  • You are comfortable taking ownership, making decisions and progressing opportunities in a growing business where processes and resources may continue to evolve.
  • You can move between strategic thinking and practical execution, from shaping a commercial plan to managing a partner relationship or negotiating a deal.
  • You are collaborative, resilient and confident working across scientific, technical and commercial teams.
  • You are comfortable representing a business externally and building trust with stakeholders at different levels.
  • You have an entrepreneurial outlook and are motivated by the opportunity to make a tangible contribution to a growing biotechnology company.

Experience across multiple animal health disease areas would be valuable. Relevant opportunities may include companion animal dermatology, pain management and oncology, alongside livestock applications such as infectious disease, metabolic health, mastitis, transition cow management and early-life protection in calves. However, the company's technology is applicable across a broad range of disease areas, so we are interested in strong candidates whose experience may extend beyond these examples.

What's on offer?
  • A basic salary of £100,000–£120,000, depending on experience.
  • A performance-related bonus scheme of up to 12%, linked to individual and company performance. This is not guaranteed.
  • Contributory Pension, Salary Sacrifice Scheme, Private Medical Insurance.
  • Flexible location arrangements, including the possibility of fully remote working for an appropriately experienced and capable candidate.
  • The opportunity to work with an innovative biotechnology business developing novel biological therapies for animal health.
  • Direct involvement in strategic partnerships, commercial negotiations and licensing opportunities with major pharmaceutical organisations.
  • Close collaboration with the senior leadership team and a genuine opportunity to influence commercial strategy.
  • An international remit, including collaboration with company sites and partners in Europe and attendance at relevant industry conferences.

The role will involve regular international travel, including visits to the company's European site, expected to be at least quarterly, as well as travel to other sites and partners as required. Occasional travel beyond Europe may also be necessary.
For candidates who would benefit from closer collaboration, coaching or support during their introduction to the business, regular on-site attendance will be important. Location flexibility will therefore depend on the experience, capability and support requirements of the successful individual.

Why join the organisation?
This is an opportunity to do more than manage a commercial pipeline. You will help shape how an innovative animal health biotechnology company develops partnerships, commercialises its technology and approaches the next stage of growth.
For the right person, it offers the chance to combine scientific expertise, commercial leadership and entrepreneurial thinking in a role where your contribution can have a meaningful impact on both the business and the future of animal health.

Interested in finding out more?
If you have the scientific credibility to engage with leading experts and the commercial experience to turn complex opportunities into successful partnerships, we would welcome a conversation.

Please apply to register your interest and our team will contact you directly to discuss the opportunity in confidence.

job.title: Customer Services Advisor
job.description:
CUSTOMER SERVICES ADVISOR
Nottingham | £26,000-£28,000 DOE | Full-time | Hybrid after probation
 
The Animal People Recruitment Company is delighted to be partnering once again with a rapidly growing pet brand. Our client is expanding its customer service team and looking for someone who is passionate about the pet industry and takes real pride in helping customers.
 
This is a predominantly email-based role where you'll manage customer enquiries from start to finish. You'll investigate problems, work with different departments and make sure every customer receives a warm, helpful and accurate response.
 
What you'll be doing:
  • Managing a busy customer service inbox
  • Responding to enquiries clearly, warmly and professionally
  • Helping customers with products, sizing, orders and deliveries
  • Managing returns, replacements, refunds and complaints
  • Taking ownership of enquiries through to resolution
  • Contacting customers proactively about stock or delivery issues
  • Updating customer and order information accurately
  • Working with warehouse and fulfilment colleagues to resolve problems
  • Assessing product faults using photographs and returned items
  • Escalating unusual or complex enquiries when required
  • Identifying recurring issues and sharing customer feedback
  • Supporting the wider business and retail shop when needed
What we're looking for:
  • Previous customer service experience
  • Excellent written English
  • A warm, natural and empathetic communication style
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail
  • The ability to prioritise a busy workload
  • Confidence learning new systems and processes
  • A calm approach to complaints and frustrated customers
  • Reliability, self-motivation and a strong work ethic
  • Someone who enjoys taking ownership without being micromanaged
  • A genuine passion for dogs, pets and the wider pet industry
We're open to people from ecommerce, pet retail, independent retail, veterinary reception, dog daycare, hospitality, store management, fulfilment or other customer-focused environments.
Experience with Shopify, Gorgias or online orders would be useful, but it isn't essential if you learn quickly and write exceptionally well.
What's on offer:
  • Salary of £26,000-£28,000 depending on experience
  • Monday to Friday, 8.00am-4.00pm
  • 37.5 hours per week
  • Up to two days working from home following successful probation and training
  • Employee discount
  • Company pension
  • Full product and systems training
  • Company-funded social events and Christmas celebrations
  • Development opportunities within a growing international pet brand
If you love the pet industry, enjoy solving problems and want your work to have a visible impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV or contact The Animal People Recruitment Company for a confidential conversation.
